caption: The drawing shows a central tree with a brown trunk and several branches, filled with multiple large, round, red fruits and green leaves. At the base of the tree is a gently sloping, yellow-green hill with tufts of green grass and a few scattered red flowers and plants with blue and green leaves. On the right side of the hill is a black and white animal, likely a dog, sitting and looking toward a small red-roofed house with a plume of smoke rising from its chimney. The house is surrounded by vertical red and green plants and is positioned near a dark green coniferous tree. The background is a light beige color and there are no visible clouds or sun, giving the impression of an embroidered or textured fabric artwork.
title: Petticoat Border
